note: Part planes' entries (docs/GAME.md 2.4, 3.5 step 4; docs/game-parts/planes.md, Interfaces), in secfind's forms ("as" a sector, a mobj or a special kind) and one more, the part's own (tools/native/gparts/planes.py): "sb:NAME", a byte of the part's scratch block (planes.s's SB_NAME), as an input's destination and an output's native place. checkSector and changeSector are helper entries of upstream's (jsr from the movers and from checkSector): checkSector takes its sector from p_floor65.s's near MP_SEC and answers NOFIT in A; changeSector takes NOFIT as it was and leaves it set when the thing is shootable and does not fit (upstream's NOFIT, natively SB_NOFIT). The movers' direction is the byte at 4,s (upstream's planeArgs reads it as 6,s past its jsr). T_MoveFloor is THTAB's: its calls are captured at callFn (p_tick65.s), whose JML [FN_P] enters it.
